name: team_planning_budget
description: Get the four budget numbers for a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in: approved, funded, remaining and unfunded. basis is the budget_basis rule: inclusive (base pay plus on-cost, the default) or base_only, and every money figure is on it. Approved is each budget line's amount, made yearly, over the days its period overlaps the scenario's out of 365, in its own currency, beside its head_count; a line with no amount approves null, never zero. Funded is what the seats team_planning_cost prices for this caller cost, each at the share its position draws on a line (as team_planning_funding derives or sets it), for the days of the seat the line's period covers, so it follows pay_view. Unfunded is the rest: the share and days no held draw funds, seats in no position, and forecast rows, which count as their kind prices them on either basis. Funded plus unfunded is team_planning_cost's scenario total, per currency, on an inclusive basis. Remaining is approved less funded in the line's own currency, and head_count less the FTE drawn. Money stays per currency: a line drawn on in another currency lists it in mismatched_currencies, never converted, and its remaining amount is null, as approved less only the part in its own currency would overstate it; a remaining total leaves such lines out and lists their ids under remaining.left_out.mismatched_currencies, so a total with any listed is not complete. Only the scenario-wide total and forecast carry `converted` and `missing`, in the reference currency at the period's start; every group sum is `native` alone. cost_centres (by the cost centre a line was approved for, null for none; unfunded money by the seat's cost centre, unfunded head count by the position's) carry all four; budget_lines carry approved, funded and remaining; units carry funded and unfunded. Head counts are positions and FTE: a line or cost centre counts each position drawing on it once, at the FTE it draws, while units and the total count the positions funded whole, as team_planning_funding does, so funded and unfunded add up to every position. A position with a seat no pay band prices still counts in head count and is listed under unpriced with no money; so is one whose on-cost is refused, unless the basis is base_only, which funds its base. Figures are decimal strings. The baseline has no period, so it can't be the scenario. strictness is the budget_strictness rule, with the preset it equals or null, and its scope decides where the budget is held: each budget line, each cost centre or the total (organisation) carries over, and the rest carry null. over.money lists the currencies it spends more of than its lines approve (null when the limit is heads or no line approves an amount); over.heads says whether it holds more FTE than its lines count (null when the limit is money or no line states a head count). A cost centre or the total spends its unfunded money and heads too. Nothing is converted to judge it: a currency no line approves goes in over.mismatched_currencies, never counted. An archived plan carries archived_on, priced_on and a note: its figures use the pay bands, exchange rates, budget lines and rules as they stood on priced_on, its archive day, while framework roles and levels are read as they are now. A plan archived before that copy was kept has no priced_on, and its figures use today's. Restoring a plan prices it with today's again. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan; not the plan's id, as the baseline has no period.
